clos.LO Details: Define management, its functions including planning, decision-making, and strategy development processes, and influence of organizational environments.
Describe the basic elements of organization design, encompassing forms, key situational influences, and components involved in designing effective operations systems.
Discuss human resource management practices, including recruitment, development, motivation, and leadership strategies, within the context of environmental factors.
Identify different types of organizational control mechanisms and analyze their characteristics to determine effectiveness in achieving organizational objectives.
Apply the knowledge and understanding gained from the course to evaluate real-life management situations/dilemma and practices in both local and global business contexts.
Develop leadership and management potential through the integration of theoretical knowledge with practical skills and self-awareness.
Understand the ethical and social responsibility issues in real-life management situations.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Marketing Principles_Nguyên lý Marketing
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
The  course is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in marketing based on five key activities: (1) identifying customer needs, (2) providing customers with the right products or service to meet their needs, (3) assuring availability to customers through the right distribution channels, (4) using promotional activities in ways that motivate purchase as effectively as possible, (5) setting an appropriate price that maximizes firm profitability while maintaining customer satisfaction.

The "Principle of Marketing" course by Philip Kotler will incorporate AI tools to enhance idea generation, structuring of documents, and practical application of marketing concepts. Students will use AI to brainstorm ideas, structure documents, and create marketing materials, while ensuring that the core content is developed independently.

Tools Utilized:

- lmarena AI: For generating marketing-related data and insights.

- Statista: For accessing statistical data and market research.

- ChatGPT: For idea generation, structuring documents, and simulating real-life marketing scenarios.

- Canva: For creating visual marketing materials like infographics, templates, and videos.

- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Consumer Behavior _Hành vi người tiêu dùng
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
Main objectives:

This course is designed to provide students with essential and working knowledge of the terminology and concepts in the field of consumer behavior and a better understanding of how consumers make choices and how their choices ultimately affect their well-being. After taking this class, the students should all be able to: 

(1) Understand basic concepts and major research that has relevance to consumer behaviour

(2) Integrate these concepts into a framework that can be applied to the analysis of the individual consumer and the market

(3) Analyse and understand consumer's decision making process

(4) Apply consumer behaviour in the development and implementation of marketing tactics and strategies.



Description: 

This course will review concepts, issues, and methods applicable to the study of consumer behavior. It is divided into 4 main parts: (1) Psychological characteristics of consumers; (2) Social and external factors influencing consumer behavior; (3) The role of sub-culture and culture; and (4) Consumer decision-making process. 

Class discussions, case study analysis , practical activities, along with group projects and quizzes will provide the basis for the learning environment in the classroom.

The assignment requires students to integrate AI throughout the project, leveraging it for ideation, structuring, content generation, and analysis. The primary level of using AI is "AI Task Completion, Human Evaluation", with creative aspects edging into the "Full AI", as students rely on AI to achieve creative outputs collaboratively while critically engaging with its results.

Understanding services marketing becomes a great need to bridge the gap between customers’ expectations and experiences. And this course is a study of the techniques and skills required for providing customer service excellence in order to keep customer service satisfaction at the highest levels possible and maintain repeat sales.

- Statista: For accessing statistical data and market research.

- ChatGPT: For idea generation, structuring documents, and simulating real-life marketing scenarios.

- Canva: For creating visual marketing materials like infographics, templates, and videos.

general_details.Syllabus Name: INTERNATIONAL MARKETING
general_details.Time Allocation: 30 sessions;  1 session= 90 minutes
general_details.Description:
This course examines the opportunities and challenges associated with global marketing. The impact on marketing of the cultural, economic, political, and technological environments in different countries will be discussed. The relationship between global marketing and global business strategy will be reviewed. Strategies and tactics for developing each of the four "P's" internationally and globally will be examined, including developing:

• Product, service, and branding policies, 

• Advertising, promotion, and communications plans, 

• Channels of distributions 

• Pricing policies in the global context. 

Approaches for deciding the extent to which marketing should be globalized versus localized will be explored. This course will examine key considerations in marketing both globally and in each of the major regions of the world.

clos.LO Details: Use the product/market growth matrix to explain the various ways a company can expand globally and Briefly explain how exchange rates impact a company’s opportunities in different parts of the world.
Describe the various positioning options available to global marketers and Understand the difference between export selling and export marketing.
Describe the various national policies that pertain to exports and imports and Explain the structure of the harmonized tariff system.
Describe the various organizations that support and facilitate the export process and Compare between home-country and market-country export organization considerations.
Discuss the factors that contribute to the successful launch of a global strategic partnership.

Compare and contrast local products and brands, international products and brands, and global products and brands and the five strategic alternatives that marketers can utilize during the global product planning process.
Identify the different pricing strategies and objectives that influence decisions about pricing products in global markets and some of the environmental influences that impact prices.
Identify and compare the basic structure options for consumer channels and industrial channels and Describe the different categories of retail operations that are found in various parts of the world.

Define sales promotion and identify the most important promotion tactics and tools used by global marketers and Compare between publicity and public relations and identify global companies that have recently been impacted by negative publicity.
Analyze the major innovations and trends that underline the digital revolution and Describe the different organizational structures that companies can adopt and they grow and expand globally.
Define hypercompetitive industry and list the key arenas in which dynamic strategic interactions take place.

Describe the available alternatives for conflict resolution and dispute settlement when doing business outside the home country and compare and contrast single-country marketing strategy with global marketing strategy (GMS).
Compare and contrast the four main categories of preferential trade agreements in Latin America and Asia
Define culture and identify the various expressions and manifestations of culture that can impact global marketing strategies.
Explain the concept of environmental sensitivity and give contrasting examples of product categories that are deeply embedded in culture and those that are not.
Understand the elements of a country’s political environment that can impact global marketing activities.
Define international law and describe the main types of legal systems found in different parts of the world.
Discuss the role of information technology in a global company’s decision-making processes.
Identify the variables that global marketers can use to segmentation, targeting, and positioning global markets and give an example of each.

general_details.Description: This Specialization covers marketing concepts but, more importantly, emphasizes the need by companies and individuals to think openly across international markets and industries for new ideas or expansion. This is summarized as "Cross Country & Cross Industry" Innovation, or CCCI in short. The first two courses will establish the core foundations and then the last three courses will elaborate on major global industry clusters: course 3 on B2B, course 4 on Healthcare and Hospitality, and course 5 on Sports and Entertainment. The capstone will require learners to develop a new product using knowledge learned from at least 2 industries.

general_details.Description:
This Course is based on the both Coursera Specialization "The Strategy of Content Marketing" and "Social Media Management", which covers both the theorical and practical lessons of content marketing. You firstly will learn the core strategies content marketers use to acquire and retain customers profitably. Specifically, you will learn how to develop, organize and implement a content marketing strategy, analyze and measure the effectiveness of content marketing, write compelling copy, use a strategic framework when writing, and build your professional brand and authority through content marketing. You will also learn how to put the ideas presented to you into action and build your own personal brand through content marketing. You will end the course with real-world application of your skills through a content management project on social media. 

This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.

AI tools can significantly enhance content marketing efforts by automating tasks, improving content quality, and providing valuable insights. Some AI tools that can be used in content marketing include: 

AI Writing Tools, AI Design Tools, AI Social Media Management Tools, AI Analytics Tools

general_details.Syllabus Name: Intergrated Marketing Communications_Truyền thông Marketing tích hợp
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
The course aims to provide students a solid foundation on different aspects of advertising and other major integrated marketing communications tools, and the role of these tools in the marketing process. In particular, attention will be given to discussions on (1) understanding the communication processes of consumers and marketers, (2) conducting situation analyses of business and social environments, (3) devising effective creative strategies for achieving marketing objectives, and (4) implementing and evaluating the creative strategy.

A key feature of this course is the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and applications. Students will explore how to effectively use these tools for brainstorming and editing tasks.

marketing strategies. It aims to deepen the understanding of how marketing relates to the key issues in business strategy: choosing customers, defining and creating value, delivering and appropriating value, and sustaining value in against competitors. general_details.Syllabus Name: Omnichannel Marketing_Bán hàng đa kênh
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
Omnichannel marketing is a response to modern buying habits, providing consumers with a consistent brand experience whether traditional or digital. This course examines how marketers plan campaigns to reach consumers at every possible point of contact and how effective digital strategies can help businesses grow and thrive. This course also covers the critical topic of social customer service, customer experience and buyer's personas development. It provides also current and emerging issues of leadership and data protection and risk in digital time.

Students will use ChatGPT/Gemini for Inbound/Content Marketing strategies



After completing this course, students will be able to: 

• Use best practices to create an omnichannel marketing strategy with a unified message, voice, and brand and a seamless customer experience

• Use best practices to develop researches on customer journey and buyer's personas

• Demonstrate an understanding of the key tactics and strategies associated with inbound channels including social media marketing, content marketing, search engine marketing, and email marketing

• Demonstrate an understanding of the key tactics and strategies associated with outbound channels including digital display, video, and YouTube advertising.



*Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Digital Marketing 1_Marketing số 1
general_details.Time Allocation:
Study hour (150h) 

= 45h contact hours +105h self-study
general_details.Description:
This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Digital Marketing", which covers both the dynamics and the global aspects of digital marketing. You'll learn about the impacts of digital technologies on marketing communication strategies, as well as the core processes of planning a digital marketing campaign and how Digital Revolution impacted Marketing in an Analog World. At the end of the course, you'll be able to select the right marketing channels for the product and know how to plan a digital campaign.

*Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes

- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

materials_table.Note: Course 1: Marketing in a Digital World
Course 3: Digital Media and Marketing Principles

clos.LO Details: Understand how digital tools are changing the nature of marketing in basic
Explain clearly how digital tools allow consumers to take a more active role in product development, promotion, placement, and pricing activities
Obtain a new set of concepts, tools, and stories to enhance your digital marketing efforts effectively
Understand the strategic impacts of digital media and information technologies on communication and marketing
Apply the concepts, tools, and knowledge provided to formulate a digital marketing plan

general_details.Description:
Nội dung môn học  thành ba phần:  

Phần thứ nhất trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của Triết học Mác- Lênin bao gồm chương mở đầu (nhập môn), 

chương 1: Chủ nghĩa duy vật biện chứng, 

chương 2: Phép biện chứng duy vật, 

chương 3: Chủ nghĩa duy vật lịch sử. 

Phần thứ hai trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của Kinh tế chính trị Mác Lênin  gồm ba chương, 

chương 4: Học thuyết giá trị, 

chương 5: Học thuyết giá trị thặng dư, 

chương 6: Chủ nghĩa tư bản độc quyền, chủ nghĩa tư bản độc quyền nhà nước. 

Phần thứ ba trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học gồm ba chương, 

chương 7: Sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân, 

chương 8: Những vấn đề chính trị xã hội mang tính quy luật của cách mạng XHCN, 

chương 9: Chủ nghĩa xã hội hiện thực và triển vọng.

general_details.Time Allocation:

general_details.Description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Triết học Mác - Lênin nghiên cứu những quan điểm duy vật biện chứng về tự nhiên, xã hội, tư duy và nhờ đó thế giới quan duy vật biện chứng trở thành toàn diện và triệt để. Áp dụng và mở rộng quan điểm duy vật biện chứng vào nghiên cứu xã hội, Mác đã đưa ra được quan niệm duy vật về lịch sử, chỉ ra con đường nghiên cứu những quy luật của sự phát triển xã hội, cũng như sự phát triển của tự nhiên, không phải do ý muốn chủ quan mà do những quy luật khách quan quyết định. Sự ra đời của Triết học Mác - Lênin đã đặt cơ sở cho việc nghiên cứu lịch sử và đời sống xã hội thực sự có tính chất khoa học.

Course introduction:  Philosophy of Marxism – Leninism studies dialectical materialistic views on nature, society, and the mind, making the worldview of dialectical materialism becomes comprehensive. Applying and expanding the dialectical materialist perspective to social research, Marx has introduced historical materialism and pointed out the way to study the laws of social development and natural development governed by objective laws rather than subjective factors. The development of Marxism – Leninism philosophy has laid the foundation for the study of history and social life in a scientific way.



Môn học Triết học Mác-Lênin nhằm giúp cho sinh viên: Xác lập cơ sở lý luận cơ bản nhất để từ đó có thể tiếp cận được nội dung môn học Kinh tế chính trị  Mác-Lênin, Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học,Tư tưởng Hồ Chí Minh và Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam, hiểu biết nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng. Xây dựng niềm tin, lý tưởng cách mạng cho sinh viên. Từng bước xác lập thế giới quan, nhân sinh quan và phương pháp luận chung nhất để tiếp cận các khoa học chuyên ngành được đào tạo.   

Philosophy of Marxism – Leninism course aims to help students: Form the theoretical framework to acquire knowledge of Political economics of Marxism-Leninism, Scientific socialism, Ho Chi Minh ideology, and History of Vietnamese Communist Party, understand the ideological foundation of the Party. Build trust, revolutionary ideals for students. Gradually build a worldview, philosophy of life, and the most general methodology to access specialized training courses. 



Nội dung môn học bao gồm các chương: Chương 1: Trình bày những nét khái quát nhất về triết học, triết học Mác – Lênin và vai trò của triết học Mác – Lênin trong đời sống xã hội. Chương 2: Trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của chủ nghĩa duy vật biện chứng, gồm vấn đề vật chất và ý thức; phép biện chứng duy vật; lý luận nhận thức của chủ nghĩa duy vật biện chứng. Chương 3: Trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của chủ nghĩa duy vật lịch sử, gồm vấn đề hình thái kinh tế - xã hội; giai cấp và dân tộc; nhà nước và cách mạng; ý thức xã hội; triết học về con người.  

The course includes chapters: Chapter 1: Present an overview of philosophy, Marxism – Leninism philosophy, and the role of Marxist-Leninist philosophy in social life. Chapter 2: Present basic issues of dialectical materialism including matter and consciousness; materialistic dialectics; cognition theory of dialectical materialism. Chapter 3: Present basic issues of historical materialism including the theory of socio-economic forms, class and peoples; state and revolution; social consciousness; philosophical theory of humans. 



Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng . Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm.

Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning group work assignments. Organizing and guiding students to discuss in groups.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Political economics of Marxism – Leninism - Kinh tế chính trị Mác - Lê-nin
general_details.Time Allocation:
Thời gian học (100h) = 22.5 giờ học trên lớp (30 tiết) + 1 giờ thi cuối kỳ + 76.5 giờ tự học

Study hour (100h) = 22.5 contact hours (30 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 76.5 hours self-study
general_details.Description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Kinh tế chính trị Mác - Lênin hay kinh tế chính trị học Mác - Lênin là một lý thuyết kinh tế và là môn khoa học về kinh tế chính trị do C. Mác , Ăngghen và sau này là Lênin phát triển trong giai đoạn mới, có đối tượng nghiên cứu là phương thức sản xuất tư bản chủ nghĩa và những quan hệ sản xuất và trao đổi thích ứng với phương thức sản xuất tư bản chủ nghĩa. Qua đó vạch rõ bản chất, hiện tượng của các quá trình kinh tế để có cơ sở giải quyết các mối quan hệ liên quan đến học thuyết của chủ nghĩa Mác - Lênin. Cốt lõi của kinh tế chính trị Mác - Lênin là học thuyết giá trị thặng dư của Các Mác.

Course introduction: Political economics of Marxism – Leninism is an economic theory and scientific discipline on political economy developed by C. Marx, Engels and later Lenin in a new period, focusing on the capitalist mode of production and the production and economic exchange relations consistent with the capitalist mode of production, thereby clarifying the nature and phenomena of economic processes, laying a foundation to solve matters related to theories of Marxism - Leninism. The core of the Marxist-Leninist political economy is the surplus value theory of Marx.



Mục tiêu môn học:

+ Người học nắm được một cách hệ thống kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi của kinh tế chính trị Mác – Lênin bao gồm: Các khái niệm, phạm trù, quy luật kinh tế chủ yếu của kinh tế thị trường; những vấn đề kinh tế - chính trị của thời kỳ quá độ lên CNXH ở Việt Nam.

+ Xác lập được phương pháp luận khoa học để phân tích, đánh giá được các vấn đề kinh tế trong nền kinh tế thị trường hiện nay. Vận dụng kiến thức của môn học vào việc tiếp cận các môn khoa học chuyên ngành và hoạt động thực tiễn của bản thân, hiểu rõ và thực hiện tốt chủ trương, đường lối, chính sách kinh tế của Đảng và Nhà nước.

Course objectives: 

+ Help students systematically grasp fundamental and core knowledge of Marxist-Leninist political economy including Concepts, categories and economic laws of Marxist-Leninist political economy; economic-political issues in the period of transition to socialism in Vietnam. 

+ Help students establish a scientific methodology to analyze and evaluate economic issues in the current market economy. Apply knowledge of the course to access specialized scientific subjects and practical activities, understand and well follow economic guidelines and policies of the Party and State. 



Nội dung môn học: Kinh tế chính trị Mác-Lênin tập trung nghiên cứu các quan hệ kinh tế trong lòng xã hội tư bản và nghiên cứu sâu về các quy luật của nền sản xuất này, cụ thể là:

+ Đề cập về hàng hóa, sản xuất hàng hóa và các quy luật kinh tế của sản xuất hàng hóa (trong chủ nghĩa Tư bản)

+ Tập trung mổ xẻ quy luật kinh tế cơ bản của chủ nghĩa tư bản mà cốt lõi là việc sản xuất giá trị thặng dư

Phân tích sự vận động của tư bản cá biệt và tái sản xuất tư bản xã hội

+ Xem xét các hình thái tư bản và các hình thức biểu hiện của giá trị thặng dư

Nghiên cứu về chủ nghĩa tư bản độc quyền và chủ nghĩa tư bản độc quyền nhà nước

Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng . Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm.

Content of the course: Political economics of Marxism – Leninism  focuses on investigating economic relations in capitalist society and in-depth studies on laws of this economy, namely:

+ Mention about commodities, commodity production and economic laws of commodity production (in capitalist social system)

+ Cncentrate on analyzing basic economic laws of capitalism wth thmain focus is surplus value production

Analysis of the movement of spcific capitalist social system and social capital reproduction

+ Consider forms of capitalism and forms of surplus value

Study monopoly capitalism and State monopoly capitalism

Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning groupwork assignments. Organizing and guiding students to discuss in groups.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Scientific socialism - Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
general_details.Time Allocation:
Thời gian học (100h) = 22.5 giờ học trên lớp (30 tiết) + 1 giờ thi cuối kỳ + 76.5 giờ tự học

Study hour (100h) = 22.5 contact hours (30 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 76.5 hours self-study
general_details.Description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học là một trong ba bộ phận của chủ nghĩa Marx-Lenin. Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học đã dựa trên phương pháp luận triết học duy vật biện chứng và duy vật lịch sử, đồng thời cũng dựa trên những cơ sở lý luận khoa học về các quy luật kinh tế, quan hệ kinh tế để luận giải một cách khoa học về quá trình nảy sinh cách mạng xã hội chủ nghĩa, hình thành và phát triển hình thái kinh tế - xã hội cộng sản chủ nghĩa, gắn liền với sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân, nhằm giải phóng con người, giải phóng xã hội.

Course introduction: Scientific socialism is one of the three parts of Marxism-Leninism. Scientific socialism is based on the philosophical methodology of dialectical materialism and historical materialism as well as scientific theoretical foundations of economic laws and economic relations to scientifically explain the advent of scientific socialism socialist revolution, the formation and development of the communist socio-economic form, associated with the historical mission of the working class, to liberate people and society.  



Môn học Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học nhằm giúp cho sinh viên: Nắm được những kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi nhất, mở rộng và chuyên sâu về Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, hiểu biết nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng. Xây dựng niềm tin, lý tưởng cách mạng cho sinh viên. Từng bước xác lập thế giới quan, nhân sinh quan và phương pháp luận chung nhất để tiếp cận các khoa học chuyên ngành được đào tạo.   

The course Scientific socialism aims to help students: Acquire the most basic, extensive and in-depth knowledge of Scientific socialism, understand the Party's ideological foundation. Build trust, revolutionary ideals for students. Gradually build a worldview, philosophy of life, and the most general methodology to access specialized training courses. 



Nội dung môn học bao gồm các chương: gồm 7 chương: chương 1, trình bày những vấn đề cơ bản có tính nhập môn của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học (quá trình hình thành, phát triển của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học); từ chương 2 đến chương 7 trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học nhằm làm sáng tỏ những quy luật khách quan của quá trình cách mạng xã hội chủ nghĩa. 

The course includes 7 chapters: Chapter 1: present basic introductory issues of Scientific socialism (the advent and development of Scientific socialism); Chapter 2 to chapter 7: present the basic knowledge of Scientific socialism to clarify the objective laws of the socialist revolution process.



Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng. Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm.

Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning group work assignments. Organizing and guiding students to discuss in groups.
general_details.StudentTasks:
Sinh viên phải tham gia tối thiểu 80% thời gian môn học. Phải có giáo trình Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, dành cho sinh viên bậc đại học hệ không chuyên lý luận chính trị của Bộ Giáo dục và Đào tạo. Chỉ sử dụng máy tính xách tay trong lớp cho mục đích học tập. Thực hiện đầy đủ các yêu cầu của giảng viên khi học trên lớp cũng như các chủ đề sinh viên tự chuẩn bị trước khi đến lớp.

- Databases: Explore using SQLite, Firebase for data management.
- Debugging techniques and tools.
- Publishing applications using Expo.
- Integrate mobile app with Gemini AI

sessions.Topic: Redux in React Native

sessions.Topic: Using AsyncStorage for Persistent Data

general_details.Syllabus Name: Managment and Marketing_Nhập môn Quản trị và Marketing
general_details.Time Allocation:
Study hour (150h)

= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of both classical and contemporary marketing theories, as well as their practical applications. Throughout the course, students will engage with new classical and contemporary cases, exploring the interdisciplinary and cross-functional implications of business management theories, contemporary marketing management principles, and futuristic applications of marketing management theories and concepts. Upon successful completion of this course, students shall:

1. Acquire an understanding of the significance of management and marketing in various organisational settings.

2. Gain a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles that govern management and marketing.

3. Demonstrate outstanding analytic abilities that are critical for effectively tackling obstacles in business and marketing operations and reaching well-informed managerial judgements.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, questions, assignments given by instructor(s)/ lecturer(s) in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purposes

- Promptly  access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

general_details.Syllabus Name: Media Psychology_Tâm lý học truyền thông
general_details.Time Allocation:
Study hour (150h)

= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
-Objective: Understand and can be  applied the cognitive psychology theories of mass comunication.

-Description: This course will focus on a range of psychological theories, processes, and principles in the context of mass communication. Students will explore the application of these theories and principles to several prominent issues will be discussed. Such issues may include politics, sex, and violence, to lesser-studied topics, such as sports, music, emotion, and technology of various media. In addition, this course examines how our experiences with media affect the way we acquire knowledge about the world, and how this knowledge influences our attitudes and behavior.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose 

- Promptly  access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

general_details.Time Allocation:

= 45h contact hours + 105h self-study
general_details.Description:
This course provides a comprehensive overview of the processes of media planning with an emphasis on the design and implementation of strategic media plans. Our course concentrates on understanding media plans, media choices, media scheduling as well as tangible costs. By taking this course, students will learn how to measure media effectiveness, make comparisons of media vehicles, interact with target audiences via different media platforms, evaluate the impact of media on its users, determine media schedule and find out the involvement of audiences with media and the data placed within it. 

Assessments will involve practical media and campaign planning tasks which showcase the course content as it will require a sufficient understanding of media characteristics and audience measurement. At the completion of the course, students are expected to gain a general understanding of the extensive range of issues and challenges related to media selection and planning in the dynamic communication environment.

Students will be tasked with completing an individual (minimum) 1800-word report concerning a current advertisement in the world. Students will be the one to choose an advertisement/a media product which played an important part in a communication campaign. And remember, a current campaign is important so you can identify easily all the media it is displayed in. At the moment, very few advertisements appear in one medium only. The identification of the range of media used will give you important insights to the target market.

Your 1800-word report should contain sections which include:

Identifies and classifies the product/service of the organization that you chose

Identifies its direct competitors

Identifies the appeal(s) used and the inferred advertisement objectives

Reports the media vehicles used and their scheduling

Reports the viewership/readership/listenership of the media if possible

Students working within a small group setting of maximum 4 students should select one product/service from the following selection and each team will be asked to prepare a media plan for it. However, the lecturer may ask students to change topics to maintain diversity in the class projects.

The product/service you may select from include(s):

A: Pepsi

Sell Pepsi to Coca-Cola lovers

B: Improve Domestic Violence awareness

“Improve Domestic Violence awareness” is the key message and mission of CARE International - an NGO in Vietnam. Let’s help them to promote this message to Vietnamese housewives!

C: Nanny app

Convince people to download an app which is created to help Vietnamese parents find some good nannies to take care of their children 

The media plan report should contain sections which include:

1. An analysis of the strategic marketing task involved

2. A detailed identification of the likely target market(s)/market segments

3. The identification of media that match the media usage of the target market(s)/segments

4. The range of target media that you intend to buy (with justification)

5. The media schedule that you intend to buy - with justification of media channel decisions and vehicles

6. A bar chart illustrating the media scheduling plan 

7. The identification and justification of the measures you will use to determine campaign success

8. Identification of likely ‘failure’ scenarios and corresponding remedial options

The campaign:

1. Can be as long as one year from its start.

2. Can start at any time of theyear.

3. Has a budget between 1,000,000 VND and 1,00,000,000 VND

Notes: 

Further details of the media plan will be provided in class. The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer. general_details.Syllabus Name: Microservices with Spring Cloud_Microservices với Spring Cloud
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 85' practical exam +102.6h self-study
general_details.Description:
Upon completion of this course students shoud: 

1. Understand the followings:

• Microservices, Microservices architecture.

• The basics of Spring Cloud and its architecture

• The configuration and implementation using Spring Cloud

• The microservices architecture using Spring Cloud.

• The deployment of microservices-based applications using Docker and Spring Cloud tools



2. Be able to:

• Explain about Microservices architecture and its benefits, including scalability, resilience, and fault tolerance.

• Explain about Spring Cloud and its architecture

• Configure and implement Spring Cloud in a project

• Design and implement a microservices architecture using Spring Cloud

• Design, build, and deploy microservices-based applications using Docker and Spring Cloud tools



3. Be able to work in team and present group's results

general_details.Syllabus Name: Natural Language Processing_Xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 121h online + 3h offline + 1h TE + 2h PE + 23h self-study
general_details.Description:
Natural Language Processing (NLP) uses algorithms to understand and manipulate human language. This technology is one of the most broadly applied areas of machine learning. As AI continues to expand, so will the demand for professionals skilled at building models that analyze speech and language, uncover contextual patterns, and produce insights from text and audio.

By the end of this Specialization, students will be ready to design NLP applications that perform question-answering and sentiment analysis, create tools to translate languages and summarize text, and even build chatbots.
general_details.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of Natural Language Processing Specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_details.Note:
1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%

3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & FR >= 5

(FR = min(10, (Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus)

materials_table.Note: MOOC 1: Natural Language Processing with Classification and Vector Spaces
MOOC 2: Natural Language Processing with Probabilistic Models
MOOC 3: Natural Language Processing with Sequence Models
MOOC 4: Natural Language Processing with Attention Models

clos.LO Details: Use logistic regression, naïve Bayes, and word vectors to implement sentiment analysis, complete analogies, and translate words.
Use locality sensitive hashing for approximate nearest neighbors.
Use dynamic programming, hidden Markov models, and word embeddings to autocorrect misspelled words, autocomplete partial sentences, and identify part-of-speech tags for words.

Use dense and recurrent neural networks, LSTMs, GRUs, and Siamese networks in TensorFlow and Trax to perform advanced sentiment analysis, text generation, named entity recognition, and to identify duplicate questions.
Use encoder-decoder, causal, and self-attention to perform advanced machine translation of complete sentences, text summarization, question-answering and to build chatbots.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Computer Networking_Mạng máy tính
general_details.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
This course is designed based on the first course of CCNA.

The first course in the CCNA curriculum introduces the architectures, models, protocols, and networking elements that connect users, devices, applications and data through the internet and across modern computer networks - including IP addressing and Ethernet fundamentals. By the end of the course, students can build simple local area networks (LANs) that integrate IP addressing schemes, foundational network security, and perform basic configurations for routers and switches.

Listed below are the current set of modules and their associated competencies outlined for this course. Each module is an integrated unit of learning that consists of content, activities and assessments that target a specific set of competencies. The size of the module will depend on the depth of knowledge and skill needed to master the competency. Some modules are considered foundational, in that the artifacts presented, while not assessed, enable learning of concepts that are covered on the CCNA certification exam.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose 

- Promptly  access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

- Students must complete all assignments on the Cisco Networking Academy (https://www.netacad.com/) with a result of at least 75%.
general_details.Tools:
Baseline Equipment Bundle:

- 2 x ISR4221/K9 Routers

- 2 x WS-C2960+24TC-L Catalyst switches

- 1 wireless router (generic brand) with WPA2 support

- Ethernet patch cables

- PCs

- Internet connection for lab and study PCs

- Optional equipment for connecting to a WLAN

   + 1 printer or integrated printer/scanner/copier for the class to share

   + Smartphones and tablets are desirable for use with the labs

Software:

- Cisco IOS versions:

   + Routers: Version 15.0 or higher, IP Base feature set

   + Switches: Version 15.0 or higher, lanbaseK9 feature set

- Packet Tracer 8.0

- Open-source server software:

   + For various services and protocols, such as Telnet, SSH, HTTP, DHCP, FTP, TFTP, etc.

- Tera Term source SSH client software for lab PCs.

- Oracle VirtualBox, most recent version.

- Wireshark version 2.5 or higher.

clos.LO Details: Explain the advances in modern network technologies
Calculate an IPv4 subnetting scheme to efficiently segment a network.
Implement an IPv6 addressing scheme.
ICMP Use various tools to test network connectivity.
Compare the operations of transport layer protocols in supporting end-to-end communication.
Explain the operation of application layer protocols in providing support to end-user applications.
Configure switches and routers with device hardening features to enhance security.
Implement a network design for a small network to include a router, a switch, and end devices.
Implement initial settings including passwords, IP addressing, and default gateway parameters on a network switch and end devices.
Explain how network protocols enable devices to access local and remote network resources.
Explain how physical layer protocols, services, and network media support communications across data networks.
Explain how media access control in the data link layer supports communication across networks
Explain how Ethernet operates in a switched network
Explain how routers use network layer protocols and services to enable end-to-end connectivity.
Explain how ARP and ND enable communication on a network.
Implement initial settings on a router and end devices.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Network Connectivity_Kết nối mạng
general_details.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
You learn what networks are and how they work. You also learn about planning, designing, and installing networks in many different situations. The course introduces you to networking theory and makes the theory come

alive through interactive Hands-On Activities. An important element of the hands-on approach is the ability to immediately apply and reinforce what you have learned.  You can use just one operating system to

practice the concepts, or you can use a combination of operating systems for broader learning.

You learn why security is important and how to make security preparations. The anatomy of specific kinds of network attacks is discussed so you will know how to block them. You learn how to secure networks through many approaches, such as updating operating systems, using IPSec, and creating border and firewall security
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose 

- Promptly  access to the FU LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

general_details.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
The Cisco Networking Academy® CCNAv7 curriculum is designed for participants who are seeking entry-level jobs in the ICT industry or hope to fulfill prerequisites to pursue more specialized ICT skills. The CCNAv7 curriculum is presented in three courses: Introduction to Networks (ITN), Switching, Routing and Wireless Essentials (SRWE), and Enterprise Networking, Security, and Automation (ENSA). These three courses provide integrated and comprehensive coverage of networking topics including: IP routing and switching fundamentals, network security and services, and network programmability and automation, while providing learners extensive opportunities for hands-on practical experience and career skills development.

The Switching, Routing and Wireless Essentials (SRWE) course in the CCNA curriculum focuses on switching technologies and router operations that support small-to-medium business networks and includes wireless local area networks (WLANs) and security concepts. Students learn key switching and routing concepts. They can perform basic network configuration and troubleshooting, identify and mitigate LAN security threats, and configure and secure a basic WLAN.

Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Promptly  access to the http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

- Students must complete all assignments on the Cisco Networking Academy (https://www.netacad.com/) with a result of at least 75%.

general_details.Syllabus Name: ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOR
general_details.Time Allocation: 30 sessions;  1 session= 90 minutes
general_details.Description: The  course is organized around three determinants of behavior in organizations: 1) individuals, 2) groups, and 3) organizational structure. Particular emphasis will be placed on individual difference, attitude, motivation, job satisfaction, communication, leadership, stress, change, and organizational culture. Vigorous class discussions, cases, activities, along with group projects and self quizzes will provide the basis for the learning environment in the classroom.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

Able to appropriately apply a motivational theory to a realistic motivational problem in an organizational context; able to provide management recommendations consistent with theory
Able to demonstrate an understanding of the five conflict management styles by explaining the appropriateness (advantages, disadvantages) of  a particular style to a specific context
Understand what is meant by organizational culture, and able to conduct an organizational cultural assessment.

general_details.Description: This specialization is designed to help students become an adaptable leader, ready to face the challenges of the disrupted workplace. This specialization will equip students with the skills to lead and navigate the ever-changing global environment we now work in. Through four themed courses students will: learn how to motivate staff with meaningful work (Become a Meaning Maker); better enable your organization to deliver on its strategic objectives (Know Your Organisation); harness your team’s diversity and use teamwork to innovate and increase your organization’s output (Know Your People), and strengthen your personal leadership skills (Adapt Your Leadership Style).
general_details.StudentTasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam.
general_details.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Final Exam (FE) = Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

general_details.Description: This specialization is designed to help students become an adaptable leader, ready to face the challenges of the disrupted workplace. This specialization will equip students with the skills to lead and navigate the ever-changing global environment we now work in. Through four themed courses students will: learn how to motivate staff with meaningful work (Become a Meaning Maker); better enable your organization to deliver on its strategic objectives (Know Your Organisation); harness your team’s diversity and use teamwork to innovate and increase your organization’s output (Know Your People), and strengthen your personal leadership skills (Adapt Your Leadership Style).
general_details.StudentTasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam.
general_details.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Final Exam (FE) = Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

clos.LO Details: Define the key organisational capabilities required for a firm’s positioning strategy as the anchoring point for leading an organisation
Identify the organisational misalignment issues that a leader should prioritize and focus their change plan on
Assess the degree of alignment between key capabilities and organisational architecture (culture, structure, people practices, systems)
Develop and present concrete, suitable, and feasible organisational change recommendations that can resolve organisational misalignment issues
Explain how individuals may differ across a range of attributes including their personality, values, perceptions, and emotions
Explain the motivational characteristics of work and apply these to job design
Analyse the implications of workplace diversity, including challenges and potential benefits
Analyze the role of team dynamics and composition in the team performance
Critically evaluate the similarities and differences between traditional and contemporary theories of leadership
Analyse how post-industrial forms of participative and self-organising leadership might enable or disable effective cross-functional teamwork
Examine the complexities and challenges of day-to-day organisational life might require agile shifts between different leadership styles
Evaluate approaches to influencing and creating meaning at work
Evaluate, create and apply strategies to leverage meaning making through branding
Evaluate and apply approaches to meaning making that play a role in aligning employee buy-in of organisational narratives
Situate discussions of meaning making within broader social contexts and concerns.

general_details.Syllabus Name: On-the-job training_Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
general_details.Time Allocation: 14 weeks (560h)
general_details.Pre-Requisite:
Sinh viên đạt 90% tổng số tín chỉ trước kỳ OJT (không tính GDTC và chương trình định hướng)
Students attained 90% of the total credits prior to the OJT term (excluding Physical Education and OTP Programs)
general_details.Description:
Sinh viên làm quen với môi trường thực tế. Có cái nhìn toàn diện về các kiến thức, kỹ năng, thái độ cần có trong một doanh nghiệp. Sinh viên thích ứng, hình thành khả năng chủ động trong môi trường đa chiều.

Sinh viên đến quan sát và học việc tại một doanh nghiệp trong các lĩnh vực liên quan đến ngành đào tạo, trải qua quá trình làm việc thực tế với chương trình và nội dung được Trường Đại học FPT và công ty thống nhất từ trước, sinh viên có cơ hội áp dụng các kiến thức và kỹ năng đã học, học hỏi, đề ra các mục tiêu cũng như chuyên ngành hẹp sẽ theo học sau thực tập.



Students get acquainted with the real working environment. Have a comprehensive understanding of the required knowledge, skills and attitudes in an enterprise. Be able to adapt and be proactive in a multi-dimensional environment.

Students come to an enterprise in fields related to their studies and do an internship, experiencing a real work process under a plan previously accorded by FPT University and the enterprise. Students have the opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills that they've gained at university, capture more learnings, set goals for next steps and make the choice of their academic concentration at the end of the internship.
general_details.StudentTasks:
'- Tham gia thực tập với tinh thần nghiêm túc.

- Tham gia các hoạt động liên quan tới công việc thực tập.

- Hoàn thành các công việc đánh giá, báo cáo trong quá trình thực tập



Seriously participate in the internship.

Perform tasks assigned by the Internship Unit.

Participate in internship-related activities.

Complete intership evaluation and internship report.

clos.LO Details:
Kiến thức và kỹ năng ngành. Sinh viên được củng cố và vận dụng kiến thức, kỹ năng đã học ở trường. Nắm bắt được các yếu tố bên trong và bên ngoài ảnh hưởng đến hoạt động kinh doanh của doanh nghiệp. Vận dụng linh hoạt các kiến thức và các công cụ đã học để thực hiện công việc được giao. (PLO8,9)
Professional knowledge and skills. Students can enhance and apply knowledge and skills that have been learned at university. Be able to understand the internal and external factors that affect the business activities of the enterprise. Flexibly apply the knowledge and tools that have been learned to perform assigned tasks. (PLO8,9)

Kỹ năng mềm. Sinh viên hình thành kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề, thực hành tư duy phản biện, thực hành sử dụng ngoại ngữ trong công việc. Có khả năng giao tiếp, khả năng làm việc nhóm, có tác phong phù hợp với môi trường doanh nghiệp. (PLO2,3)
Soft skills. Students develop problem-solving skills, practice critical thinking and use foreign languages at work. Be able to communicate and work in teams, have a suitable style for the business environment. (PLO2,3)

Thái độ, trách nhiệm và tự chủ. Sinh viên có nhận thức đúng đắn về nghề nghiệp, ý thức học tập và rèn luyện. Có thái độ làm việc nghiêm túc, tôn trọng văn hóa doanh nghiệp, tuân thủ các qui định, qui chế tại nơi làm việc. (PLO5,10)
Attitude, responsibility and self-control. Students have proper awareness of profession, learning and training. Have a serious working attitude, respect organizational culture, comply with the regulations at the workplace. (PLO5,10)

general_details.Description:
Sinh viên làm quen với môi trường thực tế. Có cái nhìn toàn diện về các kiến thức, kỹ năng, thái độ cần có trong một doanh nghiệp. Sinh viên thích ứng, hình thành khả năng chủ động trong môi trường đa chiều.

Sinh viên đến quan sát và học việc tại một doanh nghiệp trong các lĩnh vực liên quan đến ngành đào tạo, trải qua quá trình làm việc thực tế với chương trình và nội dung được Trường Đại học FPT và công ty thống nhất từ trước, sinh viên có cơ hội áp dụng các kiến thức và kỹ năng đã học, học hỏi, đề ra các mục tiêu cũng như chuyên ngành hẹp sẽ theo học sau thực tập.



Students get acquainted with the real working environment. Have a comprehensive understanding of the required knowledge, skills and attitudes in an enterprise. Be able to adapt and be proactive in a multi-dimensional environment.

Students come to an enterprise in fields related to their studies and do an internship, experiencing a real work process under a plan previously accorded by FPT University and the enterprise. Students have the opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills that they've gained at university, capture more learnings, set goals for next steps and make the choice of their academic concentration at the end of the internship.

clos.LO Details:
Kiến thức và kỹ năng ngành. Sinh viên được củng cố và vận dụng kiến thức, kỹ năng đã học ở trường. Nắm bắt được các yếu tố bên trong và bên ngoài ảnh hưởng đến hoạt động kinh doanh của doanh nghiệp. Vận dụng linh hoạt các kiến thức và các công cụ đã học để thực hiện công việc được giao. (PLO8,9)
Professional knowledge and skills. Students can enhance and apply knowledge and skills that have been learned at university. Be able to understand the internal and external factors that affect the business activities of the enterprise. Flexibly apply the knowledge and tools that have been learned to perform assigned tasks. (PLO8,9)

Kỹ năng mềm. Sinh viên hình thành kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề, thực hành tư duy phản biện, thực hành sử dụng ngoại ngữ trong công việc. Có khả năng giao tiếp, khả năng làm việc nhóm, có tác phong phù hợp với môi trường doanh nghiệp. (PLO2,3)
Soft skills. Students develop problem-solving skills, practice critical thinking and use foreign languages at work. Be able to communicate and work in teams, have a suitable style for the business environment. (PLO2,3)

Thái độ, trách nhiệm và tự chủ. Sinh viên có nhận thức đúng đắn về nghề nghiệp, ý thức học tập và rèn luyện. Có thái độ làm việc nghiêm túc, tôn trọng văn hóa doanh nghiệp, tuân thủ các qui định, qui chế tại nơi làm việc. (PLO5,10)
Attitude, responsibility and self-control. Students have proper awareness of profession, learning and training. Have a serious working attitude, respect organizational culture, comply with the regulations at the workplace. (PLO5,10)

general_details.Description:
OJT cho sinh viên cơ hội trải nghiệm môi trường làm việc thực tế, giúp sinh viên nắm được mục tiêu, yêu cầu của công việc thực tập giúp hình thành định hướng chuyên ngành nghề nghiệp cho việc lựa chọn combo nghề nghiệp kỳ sau. 

OJT offers students an opportunity to experience the real working environment, helping students realize objectives and requirements of the practicum. Thus, it helps orientate students in choosing their future careers and selecting appropriate study combo for the coming semesters.

Sinh viên được gửi đến doanh nghiệp trong các lĩnh vực liên quan đến ngành đào tạo, trải qua quá trình làm việc thực tế với chương trình và nội dung được Trường Đại học FPT và công ty thống nhất từ trước, sinh viên có cơ hội áp dụng các kiến thức và kỹ năng đã học, học hỏi, đề ra các mục tiêu cũng như chuyên ngành hẹp sẽ theo học sau thực tập.

Students are sent to an enterprise in fields related to their studies and do an internship, experiencing a real work process under a plan previously accorded by FPT University and the enterprise. Students have an opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills that they've gained at university, capture more learnings, set goals for next steps and make the choice of their academic concentration at the end of the practicum.

clos.LO Details:
Kiến thức và kỹ năng ngành: 
Sinh viên rèn luyện, thực hành vận dụng và phân tích các tình huống công việc bằng các kiến thức và kỹ năng chuyên môn đã học. Sinh viên hoàn thành các công việc được giao, và có thể có thể có các sáng tạo, ý tưởng mới trông công việc.
Professional knowledge and skills:
Students practice and apply and analyse the tasks and work scenarios with the acquired knowledge and skills.Students can complete the assigned tasks and are able to innovate and propose new ideas for the job.

Kỹ năng mềm: 
Sinh viên rèn luyện và thực hành các kỹ năng mềm liên quan đến tư duy phản biện, giải quyết vấn đề; kỹ năng và khả năng giao tiếp hợp tác, làm việc độc lập và theo nhóm. 
Soft skills: 
Students practice and apply soft-skills related to critical thininking, problem-solving, communication and corporation, working independently or working in group.

Thái độ, trách nhiệm và tự chủ:  
Sinh viên hình thành nhận thức và có thái độ đúng đắn về nghề nghiệp, có ý thức tích cực và nghiêm túc trong công việc, tôn trọng văn hoá doanh nghiệp, tuân thủ kỷ luật lao động và chấp hành các điều lệ và quy định của doanh nghiệp.
Attitude, responsibility and self-control. 
Students establish proper awareness of and attitudes about the profession, have positive mindsets and serious working attitudes. Students respect organizational culture, comply with the regulations at the workplace.

general_details.Syllabus Name: On-the-job Training/Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
general_details.Time Allocation: 14 weeks, 560 hours
general_details.Pre-Requisite: Hoàn thành 90% tổng số tín chỉ  từ học kì 1 đến học kì 5 (không tính  phần Giáo dục Quốc phòng và Giáo dục thể chất)
general_details.Description:
Vị trí môn học trong Chương trình: Là một giai đoạn học tập, trải nghiệm thực tế tại doanh nghiệp. Môn học được triển khai sau khi sinh viên đã được trang bị kiến thức thực hành tiếng ở giai đoạn trung cấp (gần đạt chuẩn tương đương N2), được trang bị các kiến thức và  kĩ năng cơ bản trong giao tiếp với đối tác Nhật Bản, về đất nước và văn hoá Nhật Bản. Trên các cơ sở này, sinh viên  tập sự giao lưu, rèn luyện theo định hướng rèn luyện nghề nghiệp trong môi trường thực tế. 

Mục tiêu của môn học: 

-  Giúp sinh viên áp dụng các kiến thức, kĩ năng thực hành tiếng vào thực tế giao tiếp và làm việc với đối tác Nhật (hoặc có yếu tố liên quan đến Nhật Bản) giúp rèn luyện tinh thần, thái độ làm việc nghiêm túc, tính kỉ luật và  lao động chuyên nghiệp, bước đầu tạo dựng và phát triển các mối quan hệ xã hội cho nghề nghiệp sau khi tốt nghiệp. 

- Qua môi trường thực tế, củng cố các kiến thức tiếng một cách vững vàng để học tiếp các môn học chuyên sâu của ngành học trong  nửa cuối giai đoạn đào tạo tại trường, trong đó, có việc xác nhận khả năng, chí hướng để giúp lựa chọn tốt hơn các môn học trong các combo theo  từng định hướng nghề nghiệp cho  tương lai.

Hình thức triển khai: 

 Sinh viên được đào tạo thực hành tại các cơ quan, tổ chức, doanh nghiệp ... đã có kí kết với Nhà trường, có sự kết hợp chặt chẽ giữa đơn vị tiếp nhận đào tạo và đại diện Nhà trường (Phòng Công tác sinh viên). Tại môi trường thực tế, sinh viên được giao nhiệm vụ, có người trực tiếp  quản lí, theo dõi,  đánh giá về tinh thần, thái độ cũng như khả năng làm việc của sinh viên. Kết thúc môn học, sinh viên được nhận chứng chỉ hoàn thành khoá học (03.22-BM/ĐH/HDCV/FPTU) và có phản hồi về môi trường làm việc (03.44-BM/ĐH/HDCV/FPTU).
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Cố gắng nỗ lực để rèn luyện tốt trong môi trường thực tế.

- Hoàn thành các công việc (được quản lí trực tiếp giao) một cách nghiêm túc, luôn học hỏi để hoàn thiện bản thân trong môi trường thực tế.

- Giao lưu tốt với đồng nghiệp, phát huy tối đa kiến thức, kĩ năng thực hành tiếng, khả năng làm việc nhóm và kiếm nghiệm thực tế các kiến thức, kĩ năng được học trong môi trường giảng đường vào thực tiễn.

- Chuẩn bị nền tảng kiến thức, kinh nghiệm, điều kiện tốt hơn cho việc tiếp tục học tập tại trường và hoàn hành tốt các môn học tiếp theo, chuẩn bị cơ sở cho công việc, nghề nghiệp sau khi tốt nghiệp.

- Tự đánh giá  về bản thân đồng thời có ý kiến phản hồi với Nhà trường về điều kiện, môi trường được đào tạo. (03.44-BM/ĐH/HDCV/FPTU)
general_details.Tools:
-   Theo tinh thần OJT, môn học không sử dụng Giáo trình.

-  Tại các đơn vị tiếp nhận, sinh viên  có thể được cung cấp thêm thêm các tài liệu, tư liệu,..bổ sung kiến thức có liên quan đến lĩnh vực được đào tạo, rèn luyện. 

- Ngoài ra, sinh viên cần tận dụng thêm các nguồn học liệu mở, các kiến thức bổ trợ cho nghề nghiệp được đăng tải trên các trang mạng liên quan  để bổ sung thêm kiến thức, thông tin, tăng hiệu quả cho công tác học tập và rèn luyện.
general_details.Note:
1) Quá trình đào tạo của sinh viên được theo dõi, quản lí và  đánh giá của đơn vị tiếp nhận qua 3 giai đoạn:

- Cơ sở lấy xác nhận của doanh nghiệp về việc tiếp nhận sinh viên thực tập trong thời gian 1 tháng tính từ  thời điểm học kỳ OJT bắt đầu.

- Cơ sở lấy đánh giá của doanh nghiệp về OJT của sinh viên vào tuần cuối của tháng thứ 2 và lấy ý kiến đánh giá của sinh viên về nơi thực tập vào đầu tháng thứ 3 của kỳ thực tập.

- Cơ sở  tiến hành lấy ý kiến đánh giá của doanh nghiệp về kết quả thực tập của sinh viên trong tháng cuối cùng của học kỳ OJT.

2) Chứng chỉ hoàn thành khoá học được cấp cho sinh viên muộn nhất  3 tháng sau kết thúc học kì OJT. (theo mẫu 03.22-BM/ĐH/HDCV/FPTU)

general_details.Syllabus Name: On-the-job training_Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
general_details.Time Allocation: 14 weeks (560h)
general_details.Pre-Requisite:
Students attained 90% of the total credits prior to the OJT term (excluding Physical Education and OTP Programs)
Students choosing JS combo (Japanese Bridge Engineer) have to pass JPD133
general_details.Description:
Target:

- Students get acquainted with the real working environment before completing the study program.

- Students explore and expand their understanding of learned programs from a broader perspective.

- Students have rich learning experiences in an industrial and globalized environment.



Implementation:

Students do practical training at partnership enterprises signed with the University. The training process has close cooperation between the partnership enterprises and the representative of the University (Student Affairs Department). In the enterprise environment, students are assigned tasks and managed directly, monitored and evaluated the students' spirit, attitude, and abilities. At the end of the training, students are evaluated comprehensively by enterprises, and have feedback on the working environment.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Seriously participate in the internship.

- Perform tasks assigned by the Internship Unit.

- Participate in internship-related activities.

- Complete intership evaluation and internship report.
general_details.Note:
1. For KS combo: Students have to study KOR101 and KOR201 at Fsoft.

2. For JS combo: Students have to study JPD134, JPD216, and JPD226 (or the courses of equivalent program) at Fsoft.

3. Completion Criteria for KS combo & JS combo:

- For KS combo: Pass KOR101 and KOR201 (GPA>=4) 

- For JS combo: Pass JPD134, JPD216, and JPD226  (or the courses of equivalent program) (GPA>=4)

clos.LO Details: Professional knowledge and skills. Students can enhance and apply knowledge and skills that have been learned at university to real work in enterprises. Completing the tasks assigned by the enterprise according to the requirements of performance and progress.

Soft skills. Students develop problem-solving skills, practice critical thinking and use foreign languages at work. Be able to communicate and work in teams, have a suitable style for the business environment.

Attitude, responsibility, and self-control. Students understand the roles, functions, and duties of different jobs at the enterprise. Having a serious working attitude, respecting organizational culture, and complying with regulations at the workplace.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Open Source Platform and Network Administration_Hệ thống nguồn mở và quản trị mạng
general_details.Syllabus English: Open Source Platform and Network Administration
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_details.Description:
This course is an introduction to open source client/server networking, basic information security and assurance concepts. Focusing on Linux as a platform and server operating system, the course introduces various concepts related to the security of Linux platforms and applications. It identifies and examines methods to secure Linux platforms and applications. It also explains how these methods can be implemented.

The course covers threats to Linux operating systems and other open source applications and mitigation of risks. It explains user account management and software management plans. The course also focuses on the various components of the Linux kernel and highlights several ways to address security breaches.
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit in time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
general_details.Tools: Internet, Oracle VM Virtual Box, CentOS Linux, vi Editor, Apache Web Server, MySQL, Sendmail, md5sum, Python, RPM Package Manager, Rootkit Hunter, Tripwire.

materials_table.MaterialDescription: Security Strategies In Linux Platforms And Applications
materials_table.Author: Michael Jang (and Ric Messier for 2017 edition)
Alfred Basta, Dustin A. Finamore, Nadine Basta, Serge Palladino

materials_table.MaterialDescription: Linux Hardening in Hostile Networks: Server Security from TLS to Tor
materials_table.Author: Kyle Rankin

clos.LO Details: Identify threats to the Linux operating system and other open source applications.
Analyze the best practices to respond and recover from a security breach (incident).
Configure the basic settings to secure a Linux platform.
Explain user account management and the principle of least privilege to protect and secure the system and its data.
Examine the flexibility of various options with file permissions and filesystem settings and how granular control isolates data access.
Describe security solutions to mitigate vulnerabilities in Linux services and the appropriate steps to mitigate the risks.
Assess how firewall, Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) Wrappers, and Security Enhanced Linux (SELinux) complement one another to secure network applications.
Assess the architecture of the Linux kernel and techniques used to enact a more secure kernel.
Evaluate the importance of maintaining a software management plan.
Establish a system baseline with monitoring and logging to detect anomalies.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Định hướng và Rèn luyện tập trung(Orientaiton and General Training Program)
general_details.Time Allocation:
5 weeks (fulltime) = 280h

* Module 1: Orientation-Định hướng 

(1 week: 8h/day * 5 days = 40h)

* Module 2: Military Training-Giáo dục quốc phòng 

(110 slots * 1.5h/slot = 165h)

* Module 3: Experience Program 

22 slots * 1.5h = 33 h

* Module 4: Vovinam

28 slots * 1,5h/slot = 42h
general_details.Description:
Orientation and general training program includes 4 modules :

* Module 1: Orientation

Main activities of this module are: 

- Organizing the opening ceremony for students. 

- Organizing health check amd making students' cards.  

- Arranging classes for students and organizing class meeting.  

- Introducing to students about FPT corporation, FPT university, functional departments, training regulations and how to use information systems to support students' learning.  

- Sharing study skills for university students.

- Sharing about topics related to community activities. ( For example: activities towards sustainable development, volunteering activities...)

* Module 2: Military training the program prescribed by the Ministry of Education and Training.

Implementing the program prescribed by the Ministry of Education and Training.

* Module 3: Experience program

Main activities of this module are: 

- Organizing research and review memoirs.

-  Organizing seminars 

- Organizing experiential activities for students (Towards sustainable development and volunteering for the community)

* Module 4: Vovinam

Follow the outline VOV114.

Objectives of orientation and training program are: 

1) Instruct students to complete procedures before a new semester.

2) Provide students with knowledge about FPT corporation, FPT university and functional departments which support students during the period of study at the university. 

3) Introduce to students about Curriculum, FU training model and regulations as well as  how to use information systems to enable students to adapt new learning environment.  

4) Educate students the fundamentals of military and national security, build and enrich patriotism, national pride through history lessons, seminars, documentaries, field trips to military bases and memoirs about two prolonged resistance wars of Viet Nam. 

5)  Train the willpower and improve physical strengths, fitness and sense of responsibilities through physical education lessons and combat practice in the field. 

6) Train team spirit, disciplines, shape good attitude and behaviors towards friends, teachers and educational environment. 

7) Enhance student experiences with extra-curricular activities. Strengthen the sense of community through community and volunteering activities and the ones towards the sustainable development.

general_details.Description:
This course equips students with knowledge of the C++ programming language from basic to advanced,
*) Basics
- C++ Keywords, C++ Variable Types, Lvalues and Rvalues, Operators in C++, Strings, Arrrays, Pointerts, C++ References, C++ Basic Input/Output ...

C/C++ Standard Template Libaries, Files/streaming ,Exception, template, multithread, smartpointer, etc.

general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 105h self-study
general_details.Description:
This course helps students answer three important questions: what is event public relations, why do we do it, and how do we do it?

This course applies the knowledge and skills needed by a public relations practitioner to design, organize and publish a special event as part of a broader public relations program or as an independent communication tool. Students will learn how to execute a PR campaign for an event and how to effectively lead and motivate a team. Students also participate in practical training to organize an event. 

- Instructors will use a number of teaching methods such as group discussions and experience sharing, practical work practice instead of conventional teaching. 

- Students will have the opportunity to present their work and thought processes related to this work.

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

Task Description:

Option 1:

Students assume they are working for a public relations agency and responsible for creating a public relations campaign for an event such as: launch product, conference, charity event, exhibition or festival, sport event... , which must include a realistic strategy for a real-life event, Students will design, develop and evaluate a campaign for a “real” client. They will meet the client face-to-face, take a brief and be tasked with developing industry-ready materials for a public relations campaign.

Or students will be provided with a list of current issues, and organisations linked to or impacted by those issues. From the list, they will select one issue and one organization to take care of.

A campaign proposal for the client must include:

Part 1:

(1) Executive Summary

(2) Situation Analysis

(3) Target Audience and key stakeholders

(4) Goal

(5) Objectives

(6) Key Messages



Option 2: For Constructivism Approach only: Follow lecturer's proposal

- Studying at the same time of EVN204.

- Participating in implementation PR for EVN204.
assessments.Note:
Students should illustrate excellent knowledge of public relations theories and how they can be applied. Critical skills in planning and execution of a public relations campaign also must be showed.

The mark will be given based on each student's performance, not on the whole group's. It means each student will get their own mark.

assessments.Grading Guide:
Option 1: Critical Essay

At home

Task Description:

The critical essay is intended to help students identify basic concepts and principles of effective public relations by analysing a key development, change or issue applied to the field of PR and professional communication.

Students will choose a topic, from the list provided, or they may provide a detailed topic of their own to be cleared in writing by the lecturer. The topics are intended to justify some of the themes covered in the course and provide them with the opportunity to gain their knowledge and examine how their topic impacts on society, publics, consumers and professional practice.

Notes:

Students should provide clear illustrations/examples in their essay to show their understanding of the topic.

All topics are written as a draft. Lecturers have the privilege to change the content of each topic as much as they want.

Choose one from the following essay topics:

Topic 1: What are the pros and cons of using a celebrity as part of a promotional event?

Topic 2: Describe the work of an entertainment publicist. Would you be interested in applying for the job of press coordinator?

Topic 3: Why is it important for event executives to have a good relationship with the mass media? How can you as a PR professional facilitate that relationship?



Option 2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal

general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 105h self-study
general_details.Description: Description: Preparation for entry into the profession of visual communication. Topics include portfolio preparation, written communication, interview, and job search skills. Each student organizes a web-based portfolio or a traditional print portfolio presentation. Goals include demonstrating and understanding design principles while revealing the creative problem-solving abilities of each student.
general_details.StudentTasks:
1. Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

2. Actively participate in class activities

3. Fulfil tasks given by instructor after class

4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes. Computer with some version of graphic software such as Illustration, InDesign, Microsoft Word for written assignments, and POWERPOINT or PDF for presentations

5. Read the textbook in advance

6. Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment. 

7. Complete course assignments with full contents of exercises and submit on time.
