general_details.Syllabus Name: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
general_details.Time Allocation:
Thời gian học (100h) = 22.5 giờ học trên lớp (30 tiết) + 1 giờ thi cuối kỳ + 76.5 giờ tự học

Study hour (100h) = 22.5 contact hours (30 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 76.5 hours self-study
general_details.Description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là một chuyên ngành, một bộ phận của khoa học lịch sử. Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh đã khẳng định Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là cả một pho lịch sử bằng vàng. Đó chính là tính khoa học, cách mạng, giá trị thực tiễn sâu sắc trong Cương lĩnh, đường lối của Đảng; là sự lãnh đạo đúng đắn, đáp ứng kịp thời những yêu cầu, nhiệm vụ do lịch sử đặt ra; những kinh nghiệm, bài học có tính quy luật, lý luận của cách mạng Việt Nam và những truyền thống vẻ vang của Đảng.

Nghiên cứu, học tập lịch sử Đảng không chỉ nắm vững những sự kiện, cột mốc lịch sử mà cần thấu hiểu những vấn đề phong phú đó trong quá trình lãnh đạo và đấu tranh, để vận dụng, phát triển trong thời kỳ đổi mới toàn diện, đẩy mạnh công nghiệp hóa, hiện đại hóa đất nước và hội nhập quốc tế hiện nay.

Course introduction: History of CPV is a major and a division of historical science. President Ho Chi Minh affirmed that the history of the Communist Party of Vietnam is golden pages. That is scientific, revolutionary and profound practical value in the Party's platforms and guidelines, is proper leadership and timely response to requirements and missions set by the history; is the normative and theoretical experiences and lessons of Vietnamese revolution and the glorious traditions of the Party. 

Researching and studying history of CPV not only requires mastering historical events and milestones but also understanding those issues in the process of leading and struggling; thereby applying and developing in the current period of comprehensive renovation and accelerating industrialization and modernization and international integration.



Mục tiêu môn học:

- Về nội dung: Cung cấp những tri thức có tính hệ thống, cơ bản về sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920- 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930- 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945- 1975), trong sự nghiệp xây dựng, bảo vệ Tổ quốc thời kỳ cả nước quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975- 2018).

- Về tư tưởng: Thông qua các sự kiện lịch sử và các kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo của Đảng để xây dựng ý thức tôn trọng sự thật khách quan, nâng cao lòng tự hào, niềm tin của sinh viên vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng trong quá khứ và hiện tại.

- Về kỹ năng: Trang bị phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử, kỹ năng lựa chọn tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập môn học và khả năng vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử vào công tác thực tiễn, phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng.

Course objectives: Provide basic and systematic knowledge of the Party establishment (1920- 1930), the process of Party's leading the rise to power (1930-1945), leading two resistance wars against French colonialist and American imperialist invasions, completing national liberation and reunion (1945 - 1975), leading the national transition to socialism and carrying out the Doi moi (1975-2018). 

- In terms of ideology:  Build a sense of respect for objective truth, deepen students' pride and confidence in the leadership of the Party in the past and present through historical events and experiences on the leadership of the Party

- In terms of skills: Equip students with scientific thinking methods on history, selecting research and learning materials skill, and the ability to apply awareness of history to practices, criticize the wrong perception of the Party's history.



Nội dung môn học:

Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên những hiểu biết cơ bản về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam; những kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi, có hệ thống về sự ra đời của Đảng (1920 - 1930), về quá trình Đảng lãnh đạo cách mạng Việt Nam từ năm 1930 cho đến nay, từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng.

Ngoài Chương nhập môn, nội dung môn học được bố cục gồm 3 chương:

- Chương 1: Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam ra đời và lãnh đạo đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945);

- Chương II: Đảng lãnh đạo hai cuộc kháng chiến, hoàn thành giải phóng dân tộc, thống nhất đất nước (1945 - 1975);

- Chương III: Đảng lãnh đạo cả nước quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội và tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975 - 2018). 

This course provides students with basic knowledge of objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV; the basic, core, systematic knowledge of the Party establishment (1920 - 1930), the process of the Party's leading the Vietnamese revolution from 1930 to the present, thereby, by affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experience of the Party’s leadership in revolutionary practices. 

In addition to the introductory chapter, the course content includes three chapters: 

- Chapter 1: The Communist Party of Vietnam was founded and led the rise to power (1930-1945);

- Chapter II: The Party led two resistance wars, completing national liberation and reunion (1945 - 1975);

- Chapter III: The Party led the national transition to socialism and carrying out the Doi moi (1975-2018).

Content of the course: 

Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning groupwork assignments. Organizing and guiding students to discuss in groups.

clos.LO Details:
Hiểu được về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
Understand the objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV

Phân tích sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920 - 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945 - 1975)
Analyze the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920 - 1930),  the Party's leadership over the period of Rise to power (1930 - 1945) and two resistance wars against French colonialist and American imperialist invasions (1945 - 1975)

Nắm được quá trình xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc, quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới toàn diện đất nước (1975 - 2018) của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam. Từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng
Understand the national construction and defense, the transition to socialism, the implementation of the comprehensive renovation of the country (1975 - 2018) of the Communist Party of Vietnam. Thereby, affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experiences on leadership in revolutionary practices.

Hình thành niềm tin, niềm tự hào vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng, định hướng phấn đấu theo mục tiêu, lý tưởng của Đảng
Build confidence and pride in the Party's leadership, striving towards the Party's goals and ideals

Củng cố, nâng cao ý thức tự rèn luyện, tu dưỡng đạo đức cách mạng và nhận thức chính trị, tư tưởng
Consolidate and raise the sense of self-training and self-improve revolutionary morality and political awareness

Nâng cao ý thức rõ hơn về trách nhiệm công dân trước những nhiệm vụ trọng đại của đất nước
Raise higher sense of civic responsibility over important duties of the country

Xây dựng phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử, các kỹ năng lựa chọn tài liệu nghiên cứu và học tập môn học; các kỹ năng làm việc cá nhân, làm việc nhóm, kỹ năng thuyết trình và trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu trong lĩnh vực đời sống xã hội có liên quan chủ trương Đảng
Develop scientific thinking methods on history, selecting research and learning materials skills, individual and group work skills, and presentation skills on research results of Party policy-related fields

Vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử và thực tiễn để phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng
Apply awareness of history and practices to criticize the wrong perception of the Party's history

Vận dụng quan điểm của Đảng vào cuộc sống và công tác, biết kết hợp với những kiến thức chuyên ngành để chủ động, tích cực giải quyết những thực tiễn đặt ra theo đường lối, chính sách, pháp luật của Đảng và Nhà nước
Apply the Party's viewpoints to life and work, combine it with specialized knowledge to proactively solve problems in reality in accordance with the guidelines, policies and laws of the Party and State

general_details.Description:
This course offers an introduction to fundamental principles of PR writing at the introductory level, with a specific focus on the influence of integrating artificial intelligence (AI). In the digital age, PR writing has evolved, utilizing diverse channels such as blogs and social media. This evolution surpasses traditional press releases by incorporating the real-time nature of tweets, Instagram stories, LinkedIn posts, and the like. These versatile technologies enable a broad spectrum of approaches to PR writing and engagement, illustrating a noteworthy advancement in public relations techniques adept at navigating the constantly evolving communication environment. Upon successful completion of this course, students shall acquire:

1. A comprehensive understanding of the transformative impact of digital spaces on information flow and knowledge acquisition, including the ability to distinguish between linear and non-linear media.

2. Proficiency in employing digital writing techniques to enhance readability and user engagement.

3. Mastery in editing for digital media to ensure accuracy and clarity, while adapting to the evolving roles of digital editors and content producers.

4. Abilities to strategically utilize multimedia storytelling and public relations techniques, address legal considerations, and combat misinformation to maintain credibility and trust in digital journalism.

Suggested assignment requirement:
Develop a comprehensive multimedia project aligned with your team's interests, such as addressing climate change. Your essay should:
(a) Clearly state the chosen topic, outline specific project goals, define your target audience, and specify the types of multimedia content you plan to incorporate.
(b) Explain your strategy for utilizing public relations techniques to expand the project's reach, address relevant legal and ethical issues, and propose methods for evaluating the project's impact on raising awareness or advocating for change related to your chosen topic.

•	Students must demonstrate their ability to produce content for digital media independently. 
•	The use of AI tools is required but will not be graded separately; the quality of their completed work will be assessed as a whole.

Opt.1
Suggested topic: 
(a) Select a news website or application and conduct an in-depth analysis to better understand its audience. Explore its FAQs and "About Us" section to determine its categorization (news, entertainment, reference, etc.), available content types, demographics of its visitors or subscribers (including age and education), content-related interests or needs addressed, and the nature of user engagement such as feedback, comments, and interaction. Utilizing this data, craft a user profile detailing the characteristics and behaviors of the site or app's audience.

(b) Find an online news article that could be enhanced with an informative graphic, such as a chart or graph. Detail clear instructions for crafting this visual component, specifying the data to be included, the timeframe to be covered, and any additional features or dimensions necessary to aid the reader's comprehension of the story.

general_details.Syllabus Name: Web Development Project_Dự án phát triển Web
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 105h self-study
general_details.Description:
'This course focuses on designing, developing, and integrating the basic Web-based system/application using React, React Native, Node.js, Express technologies (with the system requirements, technical framework & NoSQL (MongoDB) as asigned/agreed by the teacher)

Students are required to build the system with other 3-5 team members as appointed by the teacher.

After the course, students will be able to achieve Fullstack web development proficiency with the following skills by practising with other members of the assigned team.

- Proficiency in common web techniques and React, Node.js, Express, React Native development skills

- Proficiency in front end skills (React, Bootstrap) require for industry

- Analyze & design the solution following the object oriented models

- Coordinate with the team to complete the works in the form of a project
general_details.StudentTasks:
'- Build the team & select/define the project topic with arrangement/guide from the teacher

- Select the team leader and using the FPT account (@fpt.edu.vn account) to setup/configure the project managemernt environment (sources, tasks, issues, milestones) on the GitLab & project documents management on the OneDrive.

- Get the detailed assignment from the teacher, plan the project tasks, and execute the project accordingly

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final presentation.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by the teacher in class or at home and submit on time

- Constantly follow the teacher's guides/references for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work. 

- Using the GitLab to collaborate in every phase of the project by all the team members
general_details.Tools:
- One Drive or Google Drive for document management

- GitLab (https://gitlab.com/) for issue and code version management

- Visual Studio Code (https://code.visualstudio.com) 

- Internet

This course aims to provide technical knowledge and skills for student. 

Student will learn about web technologies such as HTML, CSS and Javascript. They have to practice to create website from the simple to a complex client-size or front-end web application. 

This is the advanced course of Web Design course, so student will continue their work in the end of the first course, and make an empirical version of last graphical design product in its project by applying web technologies. 

Beside the technologies, in this course student will learn about web design principles and approaches such as responsive web, and also understand techniques and tools to implement a website in a development processes. 

After this course, student can completely create a web themes includes images, icons, css(s), html(s) and javascript(s).
general_details.StudentTasks:
- Attendance >=80%

 - Actively participate in class activities 

 - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 

 - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 

 - Read the textbook in advance 

 - Access the course website (www.fap.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. 

- Computer with graphic softwares for creating website layouts (Photoshop/ Illustrator/ Sketch, ...) and web development tool (Dreamweaver/ Sublime Text, ...)

- Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course.

general_details.Description: This course gives student basic concepts and knowledge related to Interaction Design and UX aspect of Interaction Design. It addresses the principles of usable design such as consistent, aesthetic, system status feedback and so on. In this course, student will obtain knowledge of understanding users, understanding the interactions, designing for collaboration and communication, understanding how interface affect users and etc. After this course, the student have ability to collect the needs and the requirement for a product, to follow a standard process to design the product from collected requirements, to develop prototypes to demonstration his/her design ideas, to construct the design product and then performs a simple test designs such as usability testing to verify successes or uncover flaws of the design, and to improve the design products afterward.

clos.LO Details: Discuss about definition of Interaction Design, User Experience design goal and basic concepts and general principles related to those activities.
Perform usability testing and evaluations techniques to point out improvement aspects of a design product and then improve the design.
Understand interactions and how to conceptualize it by identifying the problem spaces, building up conceptual models, selecting interface metaphors, and promoting interaction paradigms
Understand about users, applying cognition knowledge into UX design, conceptual frameworks for cognition such as mental models, information processing and external cognition.
Understand social mechanisms used in collaboration and communication such as Conversional, Coordination and Awareness and the collaborative technologies has been designed to support those mechanisms.
Understand the application of anthropomorphism to interaction design to improve User Experience.

Understand about Interaction and User Experience design lifecycles, how to collect data from users, how to design and demonstrate by prototyping and the importance of evaluation in the design process.
Identify, collect and manage the needs of users and the requirements. Planning and Prepare for UX research and design works
Decide which interface metaphors, interaction paradigms, interaction mechanism and anthropomorphism should be applied or not, and determine which will be resulted into the product.
Design an interaction products for user experience by prototyping.

general_details.Syllabus Name: UI/UX Design _ Thiết kế trải nghiệm người dùng
general_details.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 82 h online study + 3 h offline + 1h exam + 64h self-study
general_details.Description:
The UI/UX Design Specialization brings a design-centric approach to user interface and user experience design, and offers practical, skill-based instruction centered around a visual communications perspective, rather than on one focused on marketing or programming alone. In this sequence of four courses, students will summarize and demonstrate all stages of the UI/UX development process, from user research to defining a project’s strategy, scope, and information architecture, to developing sitemaps and wireframes. Students’ll learn current best practices and conventions in UX design and apply them to create effective and compelling screen-based experiences for websites or apps.



Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE):  100%

Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

Condition to pass: TE>=4 and PE>=4 and FR = (TE+PE)/2 + bonus >=5
general_details.StudentTasks:
1. Student must get the certification of UI/UX Design Specialization specialization specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination.

2. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

general_details.Description: Integrate UX Research and UX Design to create great products through understanding user needs, rapidly generating prototypes, and evaluating design concepts. Students will gain hands-on experience with taking a product from initial concept, through user research, ideation and refinement, formal analysis, prototyping, and user testing, applying perspectives and methods to ensure a great user experience at every step. This course concludes with a capstone project, in which learners will incorporate UX Research and Design principles to design a complete product, taking it from an initial concept to an interactive prototype.

Be able to describe about the work involved in UX Design, including the generation of promising design solutions and the creation of prototypes at multiple levels of fidelity
Be able to describe numerous techniques to gather data from and about users
Know how to design and conduct tests with users
Be able to apply techniques such as sketching, scenario development, storyboarding, and wireframing
Know how to turn wireframes and interaction architecture into interactive prototypes that can be tested with prospective users and iteratively refined into a high quality design
Be able to describe techniques for gaining UX insights from large numbers of users, including web analytics, A/B testing, and remote unmoderated studies
Know how to design and carry out an integrated multi-phase user experience research and design project

general_details.Description:
This course aims to provide technical knowledge and skills for student.

Student will learn about web technologies such as HTML, CSS and Bootstrap. They have to practice to create website from the simple to a complex client-size or front-end web application.

This is the advanced course of Web Design course, so student will continue their work in the end of the first course, and make an empirical version of last graphical design product in its project by applying web technologies.

Beside the technologies, in this course student will learn about web design principles and approaches such as responsive web, and also understand techniques and tools to implement a website in a development processes.

After this course, student can completely create a web themes includes images, icons, css(s), html(s) and javascript(s).

Teaching method that used : Lectures, Tutorials, Discussions, Laboratory work, Group work, Seminar to help students approach the subject, understand the subject, apply it to design practice and achieve the learning outcomes of the subject.

general_details.Description:
This course introduces students to foundational writing skills for media across various platforms. Through a structured, step-by-step approach, students will learn to effectively produce content in different media formats. Emphasis will be placed on developing the writing competencies necessary for success in professional media environments. Additionally, the course will address the core principles of credibility in media writing, alongside legal and ethical considerations in both print and online journalism.

Course Objectives:

Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:

- Understand and apply key concepts in media-related business administration, management, and communication within cultural, legal, societal, and psychological contexts.

- Design and implement effective communication projects tailored to audience needs, utilizing appropriate media formats and technologies.

- Create media content suitable for multiple platforms with persuasive messaging based on research, relevant knowledge, and creative thinking.

- Demonstrate proficiency in using English for both learning and professional communication purposes.

Academic Integrity and Conduct

- All forms of academic misconduct, including copyright infringement, plagiarism, and fraud during coursework or examinations, are strictly prohibited.

- Any assignment found to have over 20% similarity (as checked by Turnitin) may be considered an intentional act of plagiarism and subject to disciplinary measures.

Use of AI Tools

AI tools can serve as valuable educational aids when used appropriately. Students are expected to adhere to the following guidelines:

A. Acceptable Uses of AI Tools:

1. Brainstorming and idea generation

2. Grammar and proofreading support

3. Clarifying complex concepts

4. Creating practice exercises

5. Organizing research notes

6. Data visualization

7. Image or video creation (with proper referencing)

All AI-generated content must be appropriately cited. Unacknowledged use will be treated as academic dishonesty and reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

B. Inappropriate Uses of AI Tools:

1. Completing assignments or exams that assess individual understanding

2. Generating essays or reports in lieu of student work

3. Circumventing the development of independent research and analytical skills
general_details.StudentTasks:
1. Complete all assignments and tasks as instructed by the course instructor, including those assigned after class sessions.

2. Bring and use their own laptop in class strictly for academic and learning-related purposes.

3. Read the assigned textbook and relevant materials prior to each class to facilitate active participation and understanding.

assessments.Question Type:
Option 1: 
- Individual Assignment 1 (In-Class) – Weight: 15%
Write either a news story or a feature story that aligns with the course’s Learning Outcomes (LOs).
Note: The use of external materials is strictly prohibited, including tools such as Google Translate or AI-based applications.

- Individual Assignment 2 (At Home) – Weight: 10%
Write a press release that aligns with the course’s Learning Outcomes (LOs).
Note: Students are permitted to use AI tools to support the completion of this assignment.

Option 2 (for constructivist approach only): Complete two alternative assignments as proposed by the lecturer.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill:
Demonstrate the ability to produce content across a variety of forms and genres in diverse news settings. 

Utilize AI tools to edit a news release for the individual at-home assignment, as permitted by the course guidelines.
assessments.Grading Guide:
Option 1: 
1. Individual Assignment 1 – In-Class Writing
Write a News Story or Feature Story
Grading Criteria (Maximum: 10 Points)
The following criteria will be used to evaluate submitted work:
- Task Response (50%, 5.0 points)
Effectively fulfill the assignment objectives by delivering a compelling news story or feature story that aligns with the Professional Strategy Triangle. The work should include relevant details, engage the reader, and follow the conventions of the chosen format.
- Structure, Coherence, and Cohesion (20%, 2.0 points)
- Spelling and Grammar (10%, 1.0 point)
- Language Choice (10%, 1.0 point)
- Use of Quotations (10%, 1.0 point)

2. Individual Assignment 2 – At-Home Writing
Write a News Release
(a) Grading Criteria (Maximum: 7 Points)
The following criteria will be used to evaluate submitted work:
- Task Response (50%, 3.5 points)
Effectively fulfill the assignment objectives by delivering a professional news release. The content should be concise, factual, and aligned with industry standards.
- Structure, Coherence, and Cohesion  (20%, 1.4 points) 
- Language Choice (15%, 1.05 points)
- Use of Quotations (5%, 0.35 point)
- Clear Explanation of AI Usage (10%, 0.7 point)
Students must submit a 150–200 word paragraph explaining how AI tools were used to generate ideas or enhance clarity and quality. A screenshot demonstrating AI usage is required.

(b) Coursera Course Completion (3.0 Points)
Students are required to complete the Coursera course specified in the course materials. Completion within the first 8 weeks of the semester will contribute 3.0 points toward the Individual Assignment 2 grade.

Option 2 (Constructivism Approach Only)
Follow the guidelines provided by the lecturer.
